ui.notice.audit: Internal audit is in the building this week. Expect questions.
ui.notice.scapegoat: Your boss points at you over {fact}.
ending.completed.title: You made it through the year.
ending.completed.body: Some of what you did never came back, and some of it cost you. Either way, this is what the job asked of you.
ending.fired.title: You were let go.
ending.fired.body: The company decided it could no longer trust you. Word travels: your next interview will include questions about this.
ending.prosecuted.title: The case went to the authorities.
ending.prosecuted.body: What you did crossed a legal line, and the company handed it over. The worst part was not one decision but the ones that came after.
ending.burnout.title: You burned out.
ending.burnout.body: You ran out of health before the year ran out of work. The job did not change; you had nothing left to give it.
ending.promoted.title: You were offered the next step up.
ending.promoted.body: The company trusted you with more. What you carry into the new seat is everything you did to earn it, and everything you chose not to do.
ending.walked_away.title: You walked away.
ending.walked_away.body: You chose to leave on your own terms. It was not an easy choice, and it may be the one you remember best.
